fieldData.description: A Radix community meetup is coming to Helsinki! RDX Works CMO Jeremy Epstein will be in town and will be your host. The meet-up will be held in the Finnish tradition, in the sauna. This is your chance to get up close and personal (and sweaty...) with the man behind the marketing of Radix DLT. Light snacks and further crypto talk will follow the sauna session. This is something new for Radix and not one to be missed!
fieldData.name: Community Meet Up In a Sauna - Helsinki, Finland
